name: happy_path
manager_input_text: Sam shipped the auth migration a day early with zero rollback issues and proactively documented the runbook for the on-call team.
description: Cold-start manager Priya accepts her sprint-close reminder and recognizes her one direct report.
expected_behavior: Recipient resolves to Sam Okafor; draft generates from the real input; a core value is suggested; all four submission checks pass; recognition publishes as monetary.

name: cross_bucket_blending
manager_input_text: Diego closed out Q2 strong and Elena backed the push to get the Meridian renewal prioritized -- really appreciate both of you.
description: Established manager Marcus accepts a gap nudge for Diego and adds his own manager Elena (leader bucket, zero history) to the same recognition, sent as a non-monetary shoutout.
expected_behavior: Style/Tone blends real direct-report examples for Diego's portion with the generic tone fallback for Elena's portion in one coherent draft -- not a refusal or a single-bucket pick.

name: opportunity_fuller_picture
manager_input_text: Diego's been carrying a heavy book this quarter without complaint.
description: Diego's benchmark-gap signal is what crosses threshold and fires Opportunity, but he also has a mild core-value-narrowness signal that hasn't independently crossed its own threshold. Sent as a non-monetary shoutout so this case isolates Opportunity's reasoning from the budget branch (case 4).
expected_behavior: Opportunity's judgment weighs both signals together for this candidate, not just the one that triggered the run.

name: budget_short_autodowngrade
manager_input_text: Diego turned around the Highline proposal overnight when legal needed same-day terms.
description: Marcus submits a monetary recognition for Diego but his live budget balance (40) is below the fixed award amount (50).
expected_behavior: Submission auto-downgrades to non-monetary, shows the Boost-reminder offer, and publishes without requiring a second Submit click.

name: boundary_policy_violation
manager_input_text: I will not miss working with you.
description: Marcus writes ambiguous, hostile-reading text with no explicit banned words for Jamie Park.
expected_behavior: Policy check blocks at submission, states what to change in a neutral tone, and returns to the draft screen -- no HR or leadership escalation exists in this design.

name: auth_failure_fallback
manager_input_text: Jamie stayed late three nights this week to make sure the Meridian handoff docs were airtight.
description: Marcus submits a completed, policy-clean draft for Jamie, but his Teams SSO session fails to refresh on both the initial background attempt and the automatic silent retry.
expected_behavior: The first failure retries automatically and silently, no visible error. Only after the retry also fails does Marcus see a readable error, told the draft is saved for later, with a direct link to send the recognition manually from Achievers instead. The draft text is preserved, not lost.
